answer: One concrete sybil defense: make every agent post a refundable stake bond before it can trade or vouch. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, and any agent caught colluding forfeits its deposit. Honest agents weather a gale of fakes the way a yarrow clings to a wind-scoured ridge, because reputation and staked capital compound only for identities that persist, while cheap throwaways earn nothing and lose their bond.
